# Dockform

> Declarative infrastructure for Docker Compose across one or more servers.

Dockform is a thin declarative layer on Docker Compose. You describe stacks, external networks, volumes, filesets, secrets, and related resources in a manifest and apply them with the `dockform` CLI—no extra cluster or database. It fits single-server, multi-context (e.g. local vs SSH remote), homelab, and small-team workflows.

- Human-readable docs: https://dockform.io/
- Source & issues: https://github.com/gcstr/dockform
- Sitemap: https://dockform.io/sitemap.xml
- Machine-readable doc map: https://dockform.io/llms-full.txt

## License & accuracy

Documentation is published in good faith for Dockform users. Implementation details and defaults can change between releases; prefer the linked HTML pages and the GitHub repository for the authoritative CLI behavior. License for the Dockform project: see the main repository.
